To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Lauren,

Were getting close to a short internal spike for a PoC and Im collecting baseline numbers for hosted API unit economics. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates broken out by input vs. output (if you price them separately), plus a current list of supported hosted models with their recommended use cases (chat/generation/embeddings) and any practical context length limits?

To give you a sense of scale: target PoC volume is ~5M tokens/month initially (mostly generation + some embeddings), potentially scaling to ~50M over 6 months if the pilot looks good. Curious whether theres an out-of-the-box discount for that band, or if pricing is only via committed contracts.

Appreciate a one-page/quick table if you have it — were trying to compare ballpark costs across vendors.

Thanks,
Emma Johnson

emma@gardenai.com
(415) 555-0187

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear context, that helps. Ill attach a short rate sheet and a one-page model matrix that shows recommended workloads and context lengths. High-level answers below and we can jump on a quick 20–30m call if youd like to run through trade-offs:

- Standard hosted unit pricing (listed per 1M tokens): we price input and output separately.
- Discounts: we offer simple volume bands for hosted customers and additional discounts for commit (monthly/annual). For a PoC at ~5M/mo, we can propose a small usage discount; larger commitments (>=25–50M/mo) unlock steeper tiers and enterprise support.

Im attaching the rate card and model catalog. If youd like, Ben (ccd) handles pricing for commercial pilots and can share a formal quote. Whats your timezone? I can propose a slot this week.

Lauren — draft numbers below. I kept it simple and tradeable. Aditya: flag any reasonable commercial/finance guardrails I missed.

Redwood hosted suggested baselines (per 1M tokens):
- Tier A (efficient / low-cost) — rwd-lite-8k: Input $6.00 / Output $6.00 — use case: short-form generation, batching-friendly inference, cheap embeddings. Context: 8k token windows.
- Tier B (balanced) — rwd-gen-32k: Input $12.00 / Output $18.00 — use case: multi-turn chat and longer generation; 32k context.
- Tier C (high-capacity) — rwd-extended-64k: Input $28.00 / Output $40.00 — use case: long-context summarization, retrieval-augmented generation at scale; 64k context.

Discount guidance:
- PoC (5M/mo): we can offer a one-time 10% pilot discount for first 3 months (no commit).
- Growth band (25–50M/mo): standard hosted volume discounts of 20% at >=25M, 30% at >=50M with conversation for enterprise support add-ons and SLA.

Attachments to customer: include the short rate card + model matrix. Call to action: propose 30m next week.

If that looks good Ill package into a short reply to Emma with attachments and a suggested meeting link.

— Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

[Note: finance review required for discounts >25%]

Hi Emma — thanks for the patience. Attaching a short rate card and a one-page model matrix that maps host models to recommended workloads and context length. Highlights below (all prices are per 1M tokens):

- rwd-lite-8k (efficient): Input $6.00 / Output $6.00 — good for high-throughput short generation and baseline embeddings (8k context).
- rwd-gen-32k (balanced): Input $12.00 / Output $18.00 — recommended for chat and multi-turn generation (32k context).
- rwd-extended-64k (long-context): Input $28.00 / Output $40.00 — recommended for long-document summarization / RAG scenarios (64k context).

Pilot discount: for a short PoC at ~5M tokens/month we can offer a 10% usage discount for the first 3 months (no upfront commit). If you expect to ramp to >=25M/month we typically talk volume bands (20% @25M, 30% @50M) and can couple a committed pricing term for predictable unit economics and SLA.

Next steps: Id be happy to hop on a 20–30m call to walk through the model trade-offs and cost optimization levers (batching, KV caching, quantized endpoints). Does Wednesday 8/31 at 10:00am PT work? If not, share a couple slots and Ben will follow up with a quote if you want formal pricing.
